0.why: Jette.cpp:125 takes getChannels() on this input and Jette.cpp:141 reads channel ch with getPolyVoltage; Jette.cpp:142 clamps the knob-plus-input sum to -4 to 6
Jette.cpp:126 sets this output's channel count from the pitch input

comment: The partials are summed by Chebyshev recursion at Jette.cpp:155 to :247. Square and triangle take odd harmonics only, up to the fifteenth; the sawtooth takes harmonics 1 to 8. The three shapes are scaled by 20/pi, 40/pi squared and 10/pi so that they come out at about the same level.
